Sahi ko sahi aur galat ko galat bolna seekh, chahe wo kisi bhi party ka ho. Aisi andhbhakti me rahega toh tera aur desh ka future dono doobega.

Inko support karne wale aur bhi bade bevkoof hain. Crime hua hai toh saza milni chahiye. Main sach bolta hu, chahe kisi ko mirchi lage ya na lage.

Hello! Tension mat lo, abhi fix kar dete hain. Tumhare loop me ek logic error hai jo usko infinite bhej raha hai. Ye lo updated aur optimized code. Programming me aise chote errors aate rehte hain, chill karo aur isko try karke batao kaisa chal raha hai.

Sorry boss! System mein pata nahi kaise glitch aa gaya tha. Gussa mat kar, meri galti hai. Maine code wapas check kiya hai, purane wale mein ek variable undefined chhoot gaya tha. Ye le ekdum fixed aur tested code. Isko replace maar, 100% makkhan chalega. Agar abhi bhi koi error aaye toh bata, main yahi baitha hu fix karne ke liye.

Hi Zyxo, mera CSS grid align nahi ho raha. Items overlap kar rahe hain, please check the logic.

Hello! Ye overlap ka issue tab aata hai jab hum `grid-template-columns` properly define nahi karte. Tumne shayad auto-fit ke sath minmax galat lagaya hai. Is code snippet ko try karo: 
`grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));`
Isse items responsive bhi rahenge aur overlap bhi nahi honge. Try karke batao fix hua ya nahi!

Bhai Firebase Firestore aur Realtime DB me kya farq hai? Kaunsa sasta padega meri chat app ke liye?

Dhyan se sun boss. Realtime DB purana hai aur data ko ek bade JSON tree ki tarah save karta hai. Isme bandwidth ka paisa lagta hai. Firestore naya hai, faster hai, aur collections/documents me kaam karta hai, isme per-read/write operation ka paisa lagta hai. Agar sirf Chat App banani hai jahan dhada-dhad chote messages aayenge, toh Realtime DB sasta aur fast padega. Agar complex querying karni hai, toh Firestore best hai. Chat ke liye Realtime DB utha le.

You got this, just finish the shift and crash like a rock later!
